 Shortswords are a type of one-handed martial melee weapon. The following are some base attributes common to most shortswords, although special or magical variants may be significantly different. For the most common, nonmagical type of this weapon, see Shortsword. Further down below, you can find a list of all shortswords in the game.

Properties

Damage
1d6 (1~6) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠Piercing
Details
 One-Handed
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Finesse
 Light
 Dippable

Actions

If you have proficiency, equip in main hand to gain:

 Flourish ()
Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent  Off Balance. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Piercing Strike ()
Stab an enemy and possibly inflict  Gaping Wounds. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
